notes.title: New Mini-Game Unlocked: 'Break It All' Awaits!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44968286/8c0431bd85fb8e3e61916399031763925bab8d80.gif[/img]

"Break It All" is a brand-new mini-game where you can smash everything in sight. Simple, fun, and incredibly satisfying—come and release your stress!"

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44968286/b3d7491a340ea150b937fd07f904dba2794dd0c8.gif[/img]

notes.title: Regular update.
notes.content:
We've added more keyboard control features—get ready to flex those fingers!
Xbox controller support is here! 🎮 Just a heads-up, you might need to do the old unplug-plug dance to get it recognized sometimes. We're working on it, promise!
Tweaked the jump tracking—now your jumps are on point!
Arena mode is now in beta, and the enemies? They're extra spicy and ready to rumble.
Making a game solo is a one-person circus, but hey, we're still juggling!

notes.title: Regular update.
notes.content: Updated the version for three consecutive days, including added particle effects to the arena, fixed an issue where sound might not play with infinite decimal volume, and several other bugs.

notes.title: Regular update.
notes.content: Fix the bug where the button may not return to its original state after feedback.

notes.title: Major update and multi-language support for Colosseum mode.
notes.content:
Added multi-language support for the Arena mode.
Enhanced the descriptions of multi-language skills in the Arena mode.
Changed the landing point detection method.
Modified the audio plugin.
Fixed a bug where there might be a brief black screen when killing a boss.

notes.title: Camera optimization and effect correction.
notes.content: Adjusted camera movement to facilitate jumping, corrected camera shake logic, and modified hit and Boss death effects.

notes.title: Colosseum sound system update
notes.content: Adjust background music switching and fix battle music position
